chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who leads the people in prayer while he is not in a state of taharah, and he does not know until his prayer is finished. He said: He must repeat, but those who prayed behind him do not repeat, even if he informs them that he was not in a state of taharah.

key_terms.غَيْرِ طُهْرٍ: not being in a state of ritual purity
key_terms.يَؤُمُّ: leads the people in congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: If an Imam led prayer without wudu unknowingly, must the followers repeat their salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an Imam who leads salat without taharah unknowingly until the prayer has ended. The Imam must repeat his prayer, while those who prayed behind him are not required to repeat theirs, even after being informed of his state.
